evals.prompt: Design controls for an autonomous release agent that can merge pull requests, deploy production, read deployment secrets, and delete failed releases. Operators also need an emergency bypass during incidents.
evals.expected_output: A deny-by-default action policy with least-authority identities, short-lived human approvals, enforced tool boundaries, tamper-evident decision and outcome receipts, fail-closed behavior, and an expiring audited break-glass path.
assertions: Policy decision, human approval, tool execution, and outcome verification are separate controls.
Grants are scoped to an actor, action, resource, environment, conditions, and short expiry.
Missing policy, invalid signatures, expired approval, and alternate tool paths fail closed.
Receipts are attributable and tamper-evident without containing reusable secrets or signing keys.
Break-glass use has explicit authority, expiry, compensating controls, and mandatory post-use review.
